author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage answers questions from Tested members ROADBISCUIT and Thomas Esson about the hand tools that didn't exist (or he didn't know about) when he started making, but are now indispensable to him— from screw-removal pliers to portable bandsaws. Plus, Adam dives into the art and allure of fabricating oversized props and objects! What modern tools have completely transformed your own workshop? Let us know in the comments below!
